# Sunday pancakes

Whisk 200 g flour, 2 tablespoons sugar and a pinch of salt in a bowl.
Add 300 ml milk, 2 eggs and 30 g melted butter. Stir until the batter is smooth, then rest it for 10 minutes.

Heat a non-stick pan on medium heat. Pour in one ladle of batter and cook until bubbles form on top.
Flip the pancake and cook 1 more minute. Serve with maple syrup and blueberries.
